```
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: voting-app
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: postgres-secret
  namespace: voting-app
type: Opaque
stringData:
  POSTGRES_USER: postgres
  POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: db-data
  namespace: voting-app
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: redis
  namespace: voting-app
  labels:
    app: redis
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: redis
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: redis
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: redis
          image: redis:alpine
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: redis
              containerPort: 6379
          readinessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - redis-cli
                - ping
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 3
          livenessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - redis-cli
                - ping
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 3
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 50m
              memory: 64Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 256Mi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: redis
  namespace: voting-app
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: redis
  ports:
    - name: redis
      port: 6379
      targetPort: redis
      protocol: TCP
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: db
  namespace: voting-app
  labels:
    app: db
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: db
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: db
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: postgres
          image: postgres:15-alpine
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: postgres
              containerPort: 5432
          env:
            - name: POSTGRES_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_USER
            - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
            - name: POSTGRES_DB
              value: postgres
            - name: PGDATA
              value: /var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata
          volumeMounts:
            - name: db-data
              mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data
          startupProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - /bin/sh
                - -c
                - pg_isready -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB"
            periodSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 30
          readinessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - /bin/sh
                - -c
                - pg_isready -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB"
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 3
          livenessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - /bin/sh
                - -c
                - pg_isready -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB"
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 3
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
      volumes:
        - name: db-data
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: db-data
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: db
  namespace: voting-app
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: db
  ports:
    - name: postgres
      port: 5432
      targetPort: postgres
      protocol: TCP
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: vote
  namespace: voting-app
  labels:
    app: vote
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: vote
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: vote
    spec:
      initContainers:
        - name: wait-for-redis
          image: busybox:1.36
          command:
            - /bin/sh
            - -c
            - |
              until nc -z redis 6379; do
                echo "Waiting for Redis..."
                sleep 2
              done
      containers:
        - name: vote
          image: dockersamples/examplevotingapp_vote
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 80
          env:
            - name: REDIS_HOST
              value: redis
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 15
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: vote
  namespace: voting-app
spec:
  type: NodePort
  selector:
    app: vote
  ports:
    - name: http
      protocol: TCP
      port: 8080
      targetPort: http
      nodePort: 30080
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: result
  namespace: voting-app
  labels:
    app: result
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: result
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: result
    spec:
      initContainers:
        - name: wait-for-postgres
          image: postgres:15-alpine
          command:
            - /bin/sh
            - -c
            - |
              until pg_isready -h db -p 5432 -U postgres; do
                echo "Waiting for PostgreSQL..."
                sleep 2
              done
      containers:
        - name: result
          image: dockersamples/examplevotingapp_result
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 80
          env:
            - name: DB_HOST
              value: db
            - name: DB_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_USER
            - name: DB_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
            - name: PORT
              value: "80"
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 20
            periodSeconds: 15
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: result
  namespace: voting-app
spec:
  type: NodePort
  selector:
    app: result
  ports:
    - name: http
      protocol: TCP
      port: 8081
      targetPort: http
      nodePort: 30081
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: worker
  namespace: voting-app
  labels:
    app: worker
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: worker
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: worker
    spec:
      initContainers:
        - name: wait-for-redis
          image: busybox:1.36
          command:
            - /bin/sh
            - -c
            - |
              until nc -z redis 6379; do
                echo "Waiting for Redis..."
                sleep 2
              done
        - name: wait-for-postgres
          image: postgres:15-alpine
          command:
            - /bin/sh
            - -c
            - |
              until pg_isready -h db -p 5432 -U postgres; do
                echo "Waiting for PostgreSQL..."
                sleep 2
              done
      containers:
        - name: worker
          image: dockersamples/examplevotingapp_worker
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          env:
            - name: REDIS_HOST
              value: redis
            - name: DB_HOST
              value: db
            - name: POSTGRES_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_USER
            - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
---
# Optional database seeding.
# Replace the image with a published image built from ./seed-data.
# Run manually after deploying the application.
#
# apiVersion: batch/v1
# kind: Job
# metadata:
#   name: seed
#   namespace: voting-app
# spec:
#   backoffLimit: 3
#   template:
#     spec:
#       restartPolicy: Never
#       initContainers:
#         - name: wait-for-vote
#           image: busybox:1.36
#           command:
#             - /bin/sh
#             - -c
#             - |
#               until wget -q -O /dev/null http://vote:8080/; do
#                 echo "Waiting for vote service..."
#                 sleep 2
#               done
#       containers:
#         - name: seed
#           image: your-registry/examplevotingapp_seed:latest
---
# Network isolation:
# - vote and result are accessible through NodePort Services.
# - redis, db, and worker are internal-only.
# - NetworkPolicies restrict communication to required application paths.
# - The CNI plugin must support Kubernetes NetworkPolicy.
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: voting-app-network-policy
  namespace: voting-app
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
    - Egress
  ingress:
    - from:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: vote
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 6379
    - from:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: worker
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 6379
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 5432
    - from:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: result
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 5432
    - ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 80
  egress:
    - to:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: redis
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 6379
    - to:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: db
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 5432
    - to:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: kube-system
      ports:
        - protocol: UDP
          port: 53
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 53
---
# Access:
# Vote:   http://<NODE_IP>:30080
# Result: http://<NODE_IP>:30081
#
# Alternatively:
# kubectl -n voting-app port-forward svc/vote 8080:8080
# kubectl -n voting-app port-forward svc/result 8081:8081
#
# Before production deployment:
# - Replace example PostgreSQL credentials with a strong secret.
# - Configure a suitable StorageClass for db-data.
# - Pin container images to immutable versions or digests.
# - Configure TLS-enabled Ingress for external access.
```
